desc: Ideation complete: reduce boundary points to perimeter coordinates and use binary search over answer.
Implement helper mapping each boundary point to a unique perimeter coordinate in [0, 4 * side) and sort coordinates.

Implement can(d) using duplicated sorted coordinates, two-pointer next-pointer table, and greedy jumps of at least d; ensure selection stays within one circumference and last point leaves at least d circular distance to first.
Implement maxDistance with binary search over [0, side], special-case d=0, and return maximum feasible distance.
Validate against examples and corner cases, especially corner coordinate assignment, wrap-around, and d=0.
